newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila sets reverse repos dated Apr 10 at 10.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Manila sets reverse repos dated Apr 10 at 10.0 pct.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Tuesday that it is offering reverse repos maturing on April 10 at 10 percent.
The overnight borrowing window will be open until 3:30 p.m. (0730 GMT).
The reverse repos dated April 10 are specially offered because the financial markets will be closed on April 9 for a public holiday.
The Central Bank normally offers overnight and termed reverse repos between 8:30 a.m. (0030 GMT) and 9:30 a.m. (0130 GMT).
Reverse repos are used by the Central Bank to mop up excess liquidity in the market.
The latest rate on reverse repos is an increase from the Central Bank's overnight borrowing rate of 9.9 percent.
The bank had also been selling three-day, one-month, and two-month reverse repos at 9.9 percent.
It had been offering six-month reverse repos at 10.125 percent.
